scope: historical seed artifacts available in runs/
44-letter Now/Diana lineage search (not present in current checkout)

frame_search_replay.online_invariant: PASS: every emitted row's debt equals a recomputation from its intact clause prefixes/suffixes; selected debt score equals recomputed overlap
frame_search_replay.obstruction: The highest-scoring rows reuse content nouns across the paired clauses (for example, letter), so they fail the no-repeat gate before reader review; rows with distinct nouns still have a first character mismatch.

seed_lineage_finding: No current-checkout artifact contains a literal Now/Diana 44-letter extension, so that claimed lineage cannot be admitted as evidence here. Existing exact historical artifacts must be reloaded by identifier before asserting a strict survivor.

decisive_next_test.name: held-out semantic noun debt test
decisive_next_test.operator: Keep the two complete clause frames, forbid repeated content lemmas before emission, and hold out all object/recipient nouns used by the seed. Recompute opposing debt online and independently audit every emitted row.
decisive_next_test.promotion: Only an exact row with no hidden span, no repeated content word, no word-order mirror, and ordinary two-clause semantics may be promoted.
